// Package planted holds one Go finding of each kind the gate tests read. It is copied into
// the module only while scripts/gates/testdata/record.sh records the samples.
package planted

import (
	"errors"
	"os"
)

// Branchy is long, branchy and deeply nested, so every complexity and size linter reports it.
func Branchy(xs []int) int {
	total := 0
	for _, x := range xs {
		if x > 0 {
			if x > 1 {
				if x > 2 {
					if x > 3 {
						total++
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if x == 4 || x == 28 {
			total += x * 4
			total ^= x - 4
		}
		if x == 5 || x == 35 {
			total += x * 5
			total ^= x - 5
		}
		if x == 6 || x == 42 {
			total += x * 6
			total ^= x - 6
		}
		if x == 7 || x == 49 {
			total += x * 7
			total ^= x - 7
		}
		if x == 8 || x == 56 {
			total += x * 8
			total ^= x - 8
		}
		if x == 9 || x == 63 {
			total += x * 9
			total ^= x - 9
		}
		if x == 10 || x == 70 {
			total += x * 10
			total ^= x - 10
		}
		if x == 11 || x == 77 {
			total += x * 11
			total ^= x - 11
		}
		if x == 12 || x == 84 {
			total += x * 12
			total ^= x - 12
		}
		if x == 13 || x == 91 {
			total += x * 13
			total ^= x - 13
		}
		if x == 14 || x == 98 {
			total += x * 14
			total ^= x - 14
		}
		if x == 15 || x == 105 {
			total += x * 15
			total ^= x - 15
		}
		if x == 16 || x == 112 {
			total += x * 16
			total ^= x - 16
		}
		if x == 17 || x == 119 {
			total += x * 17
			total ^= x - 17
		}
		if x == 18 || x == 126 {
			total += x * 18
			total ^= x - 18
		}
		if x == 19 || x == 133 {
			total += x * 19
			total ^= x - 19
		}
		if x == 20 || x == 140 {
			total += x * 20
			total ^= x - 20
		}
		if x == 21 || x == 147 {
			total += x * 21
			total ^= x - 21
		}
		if x == 22 || x == 154 {
			total += x * 22
			total ^= x - 22
		}
		if x == 23 || x == 161 {
			total += x * 23
			total ^= x - 23
		}
		if x == 24 || x == 168 {
			total += x * 24
			total ^= x - 24
		}
		if x == 25 || x == 175 {
			total += x * 25
			total ^= x - 25
		}
		if x == 26 || x == 182 {
			total += x * 26
			total ^= x - 26
		}
		if x == 27 || x == 189 {
			total += x * 27
			total ^= x - 27
		}
		if x == 28 || x == 196 {
			total += x * 28
			total ^= x - 28
		}
		if x == 29 || x == 203 {
			total += x * 29
			total ^= x - 29
		}
		if x == 30 || x == 210 {
			total += x * 30
			total ^= x - 30
		}
		if x == 31 || x == 217 {
			total += x * 31
			total ^= x - 31
		}
		if x == 32 || x == 224 {
			total += x * 32
			total ^= x - 32
		}
		if x == 33 || x == 231 {
			total += x * 33
			total ^= x - 33
		}
		if x == 34 || x == 238 {
			total += x * 34
			total ^= x - 34
		}
		if x == 35 || x == 245 {
			total += x * 35
			total ^= x - 35
		}
		if x == 36 || x == 252 {
			total += x * 36
			total ^= x - 36
		}
		if x == 37 || x == 259 {
			total += x * 37
			total ^= x - 37
		}
		if x == 38 || x == 266 {
			total += x * 38
			total ^= x - 38
		}
		if x == 39 || x == 273 {
			total += x * 39
			total ^= x - 39
		}
		if x == 40 || x == 280 {
			total += x * 40
			total ^= x - 40
		}
		if x == 41 || x == 287 {
			total += x * 41
			total ^= x - 41
		}
		if x == 42 || x == 294 {
			total += x * 42
			total ^= x - 42
		}
		if x == 43 || x == 301 {
			total += x * 43
			total ^= x - 43
		}
		if x == 44 || x == 308 {
			total += x * 44
			total ^= x - 44
		}
		if x == 45 || x == 315 {
			total += x * 45
			total ^= x - 45
		}
		if x == 46 || x == 322 {
			total += x * 46
			total ^= x - 46
		}
		if x == 47 || x == 329 {
			total += x * 47
			total ^= x - 47
		}
		if x == 48 || x == 336 {
			total += x * 48
			total ^= x - 48
		}
		if x == 49 || x == 343 {
			total += x * 49
			total ^= x - 49
		}
		if x == 50 || x == 350 {
			total += x * 50
			total ^= x - 50
		}
		if x == 51 || x == 357 {
			total += x * 51
			total ^= x - 51
		}
		if x == 52 || x == 364 {
			total += x * 52
			total ^= x - 52
		}
		if x == 53 || x == 371 {
			total += x * 53
			total ^= x - 53
		}
		if x == 54 || x == 378 {
			total += x * 54
			total ^= x - 54
		}
		if x == 55 || x == 385 {
			total += x * 55
			total ^= x - 55
		}
		if x == 56 || x == 392 {
			total += x * 56
			total ^= x - 56
		}
		if x == 57 || x == 399 {
			total += x * 57
			total ^= x - 57
		}
		if x == 58 || x == 406 {
			total += x * 58
			total ^= x - 58
		}
		if x == 59 || x == 413 {
			total += x * 59
			total ^= x - 59
		}
		if x == 60 || x == 420 {
			total += x * 60
			total ^= x - 60
		}
		if x == 61 || x == 427 {
			total += x * 61
			total ^= x - 61
		}
		if x == 62 || x == 434 {
			total += x * 62
			total ^= x - 62
		}
		if x == 63 || x == 441 {
			total += x * 63
			total ^= x - 63
		}
	}
	return total
}

// Long is one statement over more lines than the limit.

	return []int{

		52,

	}
}

// SixArguments takes one argument over the limit.
func SixArguments(a, b, c, d, e, f int) int { return a + b + c + d + e + f }

// SevenArguments takes two arguments over the limit.
func SevenArguments(a, b, c, d, e, f, g int) int { return a + b + c + d + e + f + g }

// The first long line: this comment runs on past the line-length limit of one hundred and twenty characters, so lll reports it.
// The second long line: this comment is longer still, and it runs on well past the line-length limit of one hundred and twenty characters.

// Remove drops the error os.Remove returns.
func Remove(s string) {
	os.Remove(s)
}

// Check returns nil where it holds a non-nil error.
func Check() error {
	err := errors.New("x")
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	return err
}
